newsitem.title: USA: SPX Corp Q3 net, revenues higher.
newsitem.headline: SPX Corp Q3 net, revenues higher.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q3 net includes extraordinary loss of $774,000 or $0.05 a share from repurchase of some notes, and restructuring charges of $2 million or $0.14 a share.
1995 Q3 net includes gain from continuing operations equal to $0.32 a share, loss from discontinued operations equal to $0.23 a share, and loss from repurchase of some notes equal to $0.04 a share.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1996 nine months net includes extraordinary loss of $1.2 million or $0.08 a share from repurchase of some notes, and restructuring charges of $15.9 million (pre-tax) or $0.71 a share.

1995 nine months net includes gain from continuing operations equal to $0.61 a share, loss from discontinued operations equal to $0.22 a share, and extraordinary loss from repurchase of some notes equal to $0.06 a share.
